paper.abstract_en: An event becomes a fact when enough independent records of it exist such that no operation is possible that leaves all observers ignorant of it again. Records are physical, and creating, keeping, and destroying them have thermodynamic costs. We compute these costs exactly in a minimal broadcast model with a driven central qubit writing records into $N$ initially thermal registers, with work sources and baths at temperature $T$. The basic arguments for the operations are outlined here, with full treatment in the text. Creation of one event record at redundancy $R$ and information deficit $δ$ requires work $W \ge R\, k_\mathrm{B}T \ln 2\, (1-δ) H(\varepsilon)$, linear in redundancy at the Landauer coefficient. Recording in a basis misaligned by $θ$ with the einselecting interaction fails at a critical angle, $θ_c = 2\arcsin\sqrt{H_2^{-1}(δ)}$, beyond which objectivity is unreachable at any work, and below $θ_c$ the optimal work is a closed form in the pointer basis that minimizes the work of objectivity. Reducing objectivity is impossible at any work with access to fewer than $R - R_{\min} + 1$ records, while work protects nothing if given access. Inter-record redundancy is extractable free energy and erasing the accessed records yields a net gain of work beyond the first copy. The second law constrains the destruction of the correlation: erasing a fact from a sector an adversary controls dissipates at least the mutual information erased, but a consolidation dissipates nothing. Records in re-thermalizing media are nonequilibrium steady states, and the minimal power to maintain a record at $(R,δ)$ is the known two-state driving bound evaluated at the record-quality boundary.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该文讨论量子达尔文主义/客观性的热力学代价（记录、冗余、擦除、Landauer界），属于量子信息与统计物理交叉研究，并非黑洞热力学；与候选主题black_hole_thermodynamics缺乏实质关联，也未涉及度规仿射引力、Palatini或修改引力。
decision.abstract_zh: 当一个事件存在足够多的独立记录，以致无法进行任何操作再让所有观察者对其一无所知时，这个事件就成为事实。记录是物理的，创建、保存与销毁记录都具有热力学代价。我们在一个最小广播模型中精确计算这些代价：一个被驱动的中心量子比特把记录写入 $N$ 个初始处于热态的寄存器，并配备功源与温度为 $T$ 的热浴。这里概述各操作的基本论证，完整处理见正文。在冗余度 $R$ 与信息亏损 $δ$ 下创建一个事件记录所需功为 $W \ge R\, k_\mathrm{B}T \ln 2\, (1-δ) H(\varepsilon)$，在冗余度上线性，系数为 Landauer 系数。若在相对本征选择相互作用偏角 $θ$ 的基上记录，则存在临界角 $θ_c = 2\arcsin\sqrt{H_2^{-1}(δ)}$，超过该角则无论多少功都无法达成客观性；低于 $θ_c$ 时，最优功是指针基下的闭式表达，使客观性所需功最小。若可获取的记录少于 $R - R_{\min} + 1$，则无论多少功都不可能降低客观性；而一旦获得访问权，功也保护不了任何东西。记录间的冗余是可提取的自由能，擦除被访问的记录可获得超出第一份拷贝的净功增益。第二定律约束关联的销毁：从对手控制的扇区擦除一个事实至少耗散所擦除的互信息，而合并则不耗散任何东西。处于再热化介质中的记录是非平衡稳态，在 $(R,δ)$ 下维持一条记录所需的最小功率，是已知的两态驱动界限在记录质量边界处的取值。
